newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seesaw to finish slightlly down.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seesaw to finish slightlly down.

text.p: Pakistani stocks moved both ways on Thursday before ending lower as blue chips fell on a correction, but dealers said the index would stablise at these levels.

"The market is taking a breather after its swift run-up from 1,500 points to 2,000 and above during the last few weeks," dealer Dawar Hasan said."Genuine buying, which earlier was limited to a handful of blue chips, has now spilled over to other stocks also."
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 2.78 points, or 0.14 percent, to end at 2,024.05. Gainers led losers 154 to 83. Pak State Oil fell 8.0 rupees to 425.
